caseNameFull: Andrews v. United States and Donovan v. United States

opinions.text: Certiorari, ante, p. 812, to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit. The motions for the appointment of counsel are granted and it is ordered that E. Barrett Prettyman, Jr., Esquire, of Washington, D. C., a member of the Bar of this Court, be, and he is hereby, appointed to serve as counsel for petitioners in these cases.
